title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark's CJ CUP lead
items.text: Wyndham Clark finished the CJ CUP Byron Nelson at a tournament-best -30, holding a four-shot lead over Si Woo Kim (-27).

items.headline: Collin Morikawa’s Pebble Beach edge
items.text: Collin Morikawa completed the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am at -22, one stroke ahead of Min Woo Lee and Sepp Straka (-21).

items.headline: Ryan Fox leads The Open
items.text: Ryan Fox finished The Open Championship at -10, one shot ahead of Cameron Young (-9) with Sam Burns third at -8.
